title: Data transfer
description: SMB transfers, scoped sync setup, and opt-in agent control of saved local/cluster Git syncs through the running console.

available.message: Sign in through Data Transfer or run smbshell login; agents require a Kerberos ticket and do not use saved passwords.

list.title: List a folder on the SMB server
list.description: Files and folders in REMOTE using smbclient, as structured entries: Path, Name, Size, ModTime, IsDir.

remote.description: a folder relative to the server folder

get.title: Copy from the SMB server
get.description: Copies REMOTE (a file or folder on the server) into LOCAL, a new directory in your work directories, as a SLURM job; follow it with job_status or wait_for_job.

remote.description: a file or folder relative to the server folder

local.description: a new directory to copy into (it must not exist)

put.title: Copy to the SMB server
put.description: Copies LOCAL (a file or folder in your work directories) to REMOTE, a folder on the server, as a SLURM job. It adds and replaces files there; it deletes nothing. Off unless the cluster's owner turns it on.

local.description: a file or folder in your work directories

remote.description: a folder relative to the server folder

sync_inspect.title: Inspect sync context
sync_inspect.description: Read the cluster directory sync metadata and default ignore context without writing files. Local console registrations are unchanged.

root.description: an existing directory in the token work roots; mutations only change .hpclib-sync.json and a reviewed .gitignore

available.message: Update hpclib on this cluster to enable sync context actions.

sync_setup_preview.title: Preview sync ignore setup
sync_setup_preview.description: Read the cluster directory sync metadata and default ignore context without writing files. Local console registrations are unchanged.

root.description: an existing directory in the token work roots; mutations only change .hpclib-sync.json and a reviewed .gitignore

available.message: Update hpclib on this cluster to enable sync context actions.

sync_setup.title: Save reviewed sync ignore setup
sync_setup.description: Apply a reviewed cluster-side ignore choice and portable metadata. Requires explicit confirm and a fresh sync_setup_preview token. Does not commit or transfer files.

root.description: an existing directory in the token work roots; mutations only change .hpclib-sync.json and a reviewed .gitignore

review.description: the review token returned by sync_setup_preview

mode.description: merge defaults into .gitignore, use private sync exclusions, or decline defaults

confirm.description: explicitly confirm the reviewed metadata writes

available.message: Update hpclib on this cluster to enable sync context actions.

sync_settings.title: Change reviewed sync warning settings
sync_settings.description: Update selected warning thresholds in existing cluster-side sync metadata. Zero leaves a value unchanged. Requires a current preview and explicit confirm; local console registrations are unchanged.

root.description: an existing directory in the token work roots; mutations only change .hpclib-sync.json and a reviewed .gitignore

review.description: the review token returned by sync_setup_preview

confirm.description: explicitly confirm the reviewed metadata writes

warn_file_mb.description: per-file warning in decimal MB; zero leaves unchanged

warn_snapshot_mb.description: aggregate snapshot warning in decimal MB; zero leaves unchanged

warn_file_count.description: changed-file warning count; zero leaves unchanged

available.message: Update hpclib on this cluster to enable sync context actions.

sync_query.title: Query saved Git syncs
sync_query.description: List permitted agent-enabled syncs, get status/plan, or poll a request ticket. The console must be running for new queries; ticket polling works while it is offline. Results never expose other clusters or out-of-scope groups.

root.description: existing scoped remote sync directory; list/request-status also accept its parent directory

operation.description: list returns IDs/revisions; status/plan are asynchronous requests; request-status polls ticket

id.description: sync group ID returned by list

plan.description: current plan ID returned by sync status or plan query

ticket.description: ticket returned by sync_query or sync_manage

available.message: Update both ends to hpclib 1.14.5; open the console, connect the cluster and Allow agent access for the sync.

sync_manage.title: Manage reviewed Git syncs
sync_manage.description: Request review, size approval, apply/retry, pause/resume or warning configuration from the same console sync manager. Requires local per-sync consent, files:write, current revision and confirm=true. Apply/retry/approve-snapshot require the exact reviewed plan. Poll the returned ticket, then query status for the run.

root.description: existing scoped remote sync directory; list/request-status also accept its parent directory

operation.description: review creates snapshots and a merge preview; apply/retry change local and remote files only under the exact plan

id.description: sync group ID returned by list

plan.description: current plan ID returned by sync status or plan query

confirm.description: explicit consent for this command; false performs no command

warn_file_mb.description: configure only: per-file warning MB; zero leaves unchanged

warn_snapshot_mb.description: configure only: aggregate warning MB; zero leaves unchanged

warn_file_count.description: configure only: changed-file count warning; zero leaves unchanged

available.message: Update both ends to hpclib 1.14.5; open the console, connect the cluster and Allow agent access for the sync.
